run_interop_tests: run gRPC cross-language interop tests in parallel across multiple languages using docker containers
cloud_to_prod_jobspec: create a jobspec for cloud-to-prod interop tests with TLS or custom credentials against a production server
cloud_to_cloud_jobspec: create a jobspec for cloud-to-cloud interop tests between a client language and a server language
server_jobspec: create a jobspec for running an interop test server in a docker container with health checks
build_interop_image_jobspec: create a jobspec for building a docker image for a specific language interop test environment
